'''Rinko Natsuhi''' (Japanese: '''夏日凜子''' ''Natsuhi Rinko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Natsuhi was born on October 21, 1986, and became a voice actress as an adult. She was affiliated with {{wp|Across Entertainment}} and mostly got minor roles in anime series. Natsuhi became involved with the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, voicing her best-known role to date, [[Team Flare]] scientist [[Aliana]].

* Mother, Passerby B (''{{wp|Ushio and Tora}}'' (eps. 9, 13))
* Citizen (''{{wp|Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress}}'' (ep. 4))

==Trivia==
* Natsuhi is involved with the same talent agency as [[Mariya Ise]], the voice actor of {{an|Bonnie}} and other {{aniseries|PTS}} characters.
